status: PREDECLARED before any Gate X candidate timing. bench/measure.py records this file's sha256 with every result. Changing it after seeing results starts a new experiment; it does not amend this one.
scope: Captured-driver work of the hidden Unicode check only: capture decoding, checks and per-line reporting in a fresh process. Not a complete action, not Git, not event parsing, not a job or billing claim.
warmup_use: Recorded as first-run observations; never part of a median or a decision.
order: Every round runs each (case, contestant) pair exactly once, in the order of random.Random(seed * 100 + round).shuffle over the sorted pairs. The order is recorded.
case_generation: bench/gen_corpora.py, before the clock starts; every capture must hash to its pinned value.

contestants.python-faithful: CPython 3.14 (unicodedata 16.0.0), agent_guardrails at 40382e2 verified by hash, bench/py_driver.py faithful. The parity oracle and the decision baseline.
contestants.python-tuned: The same interpreter with bench/hidden_tuned.py swapped in: the named optimized Python, never a substitute baseline.
contestants.rust-packaged: bash launch.sh with the committed asset for this machine: platform selection, mktemp -d under a harness-owned RUNNER_TEMP, gzip -d, chmod, the native drive, and removal of the directory. The decision candidate.
contestants.rust-extracted: Component only: the same ELF, extracted once before timing, drive only. Separates native startup plus checking from packaging.
contestants.gunzip-only: Component only: gzip -d -c of the committed asset into a file. Separates decompression from everything else.
contestants.python312-control: Control only, when the runner has it: the system python3 3.12 (unicodedata 15.0.0) with the faithful driver. Its parity is reported, not required, and it is not a decision input.

boundaries.wall_ns: time.perf_counter_ns() immediately before starting the process to immediately after os.wait4 reaps it; a pidfd wakes the harness at exit.
boundaries.cpu_s: ru_utime + ru_stime from os.wait4, which include the children that process waited for (gzip and the binary under the launcher).
boundaries.maxrss_kib: ru_maxrss from os.wait4: the largest resident set of the process and the children it waited for.
boundaries.output: exit status, stdout length and sha256, stderr length. stdout and stderr go to regular files.
boundaries.cleanup: After every rust-packaged run the harness-owned RUNNER_TEMP must be empty again.

parity: In every timed and warmup run of every case, rust-packaged, rust-extracted and python-tuned must match python-faithful's exit status and stdout bytes, with empty stderr. Any mismatch, timeout, unexpected exit status or leftover RUNNER_TEMP entry fails the gate. Gate U's accepted UCD 16 differences do not apply: python-faithful already uses UCD 16.

decision.small_rule: median(rust-packaged) - median(python-faithful) <= max(5 ms, 5% of median(python-faithful))
decision.large_rule: median(python-faithful) - median(rust-packaged) >= 100 ms and >= 20% of median(python-faithful)
decision.paired_difference: For each case and round, rust-packaged wall minus python-faithful wall of the same round.
decision.uncertainty: The median and the [min, max] of the seven paired differences. With seven rounds, [min, max] is a distribution-free 98.4% interval for the median paired difference (sign test).
decision.verdict: PASS when the medians satisfy the rule and the whole paired interval does too; FAIL when the medians violate it and the whole interval does too; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
decision.gate: Captured-driver part of Gate X passes on an architecture only if parity holds everywhere and every small and large rule is PASS. It never passes on emulated hardware: an emulated result is labelled and kept for correctness only.

rerun_policy: At most one follow-up measurement, only for a methodological defect named and recorded before it starts. Never to obtain a different winner.
not_measured_here: action download and preparation by the runner (ci/transfer-template.yml)
Git acquisition, event parsing, identity and attribution checks
